sections.title: Overview
sections.content:
For other uses, see Gilbert.

Gilbert is a character introduced in Brave Frontier II.

sections.title: In Brave Frontier I
sections.content: As part of the Battles of Brave Frontier 2 series, Gilbert can be fought in The Righteous Sheriff.

sections.title: Brave Frontier Heroes
sections.content: A sheriff protecting the lives of people in a western town. He once experienced a corrupt merchant swindling his parents' ranch, which instilled in him a hatred for evil and a drive to uphold justice, leading him to become a sheriff. Being a former cowherd, he's top-notch with a lasso, preferring to capture criminals alive rather than shooting them. Since the bandit group started to dominate the town, he found himself overwhelmed. To soothe the disturbed hearts of the townsfolk, he adopted exaggerated words and gestures. He believes that this, too, is a form of justice.
